query:
SELECT 
  sac.state,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sac."nextFollowUpAt" <= NOW() OR sac."nextFollowUpAt" IS NULL THEN 1 END) as ready_now,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p."contactEmail" IS NOT NULL AND p."contactEmail" != '' THEN 1 END) as has_email
FROM sales_agent_conversations sac
JOIN prospects p ON p.id = sac."prospectId"
WHERE sac.state IN ('discovery', 'intro_sent', 'followup_1', 'followup_2')
GROUP BY sac.state
ORDER BY sac.state;
